illustrations.text: A syndicate's contract killing results in death: s.111(2)(a), death or life and fine not less than ten lakh rupees.
A syndicate's extortion racket, no death: s.111(2)(b), five years to life and fine not less than five lakh rupees.
Conspiring to commit the syndicate's robbery: s.111(3).
Being a member of the syndicate: s.111(4).
Hiding a syndicate member who committed organised crime: s.111(5).
Possessing the proceeds of the syndicate's vehicle theft: s.111(6).
Holding property for a syndicate member that he cannot satisfactorily account for: s.111(7).
Conduct that is not organised crime is not s.111, whatever the role.
Organised crime occurred but the accused has no punishable role: not s.111.

in_scope: s.111(2)(a) committing organised crime resulting in death (death or life, fine not less than ten lakh rupees)
s.111(2)(b) committing organised crime, other cases (five years to life, fine not less than five lakh rupees)
s.111(3) abetting, attempting, conspiring, facilitating or preparatory acts (five years to life, fine not less than five lakh rupees)
s.111(4) membership of an organised crime syndicate (five years to life, fine not less than five lakh rupees)
s.111(5) harbouring or concealing an offender (three years to life, fine not less than five lakh rupees)
s.111(6) possessing property derived from organised crime (three years to life, fine not less than two lakh rupees)
s.111(7) possessing unaccounted property on behalf of a syndicate member (three to ten years, fine not less than one lakh rupees)
out_of_scope: s.112 petty organised crime (separate pack in.bns.petty-organised-crime)
the underlying offences (kidnapping, extortion, etc.) charged separately
sentencing discretion within the maxima and the fine minima
